risk_paths.path_name: Flow control manifests or clients still use flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta1
risk_paths.description: Upgrading to Kubernetes 1.26 or later removes the served flow-control v1beta1 API, so workloads that still create, update, or query FlowSchema or PriorityLevelConfiguration using v1beta1 can fail and require migration work.

conditions.statement: Target cluster version is 1.26 or later, where the v1beta1 API is no longer served

evidence.quote_or_summary: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta1 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.26.
evidence.relevance: Manifests and clients using the v1beta1 flow-control API must be updated before upgrading to v1.26.

conditions.reasoning: The fact states the v1beta1 API is no longer served as of v1.26, so any target at or beyond that version introduces the removal.

conditions.statement: The application or deployment contains flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta1 usage for FlowSchema or PriorityLevelConfiguration

conditions.reasoning: Only code or manifests still using the removed API version are affected.
